section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section presents findings from a single study examining the factor structure and validity of the Portuguese Acceptance of Cosmetic Surgery Scale (ACSS) among Brazilian adults. The study found a three-factor structure similar to the original scale, adequate convergent validity with body appreciation and BMI, and few significant sex differences in acceptance of cosmetic surgery between men and women. The authors acknowledge several limitations including lack of socioeconomic data, a smaller male sample, and the use of Western-developed scales that may not capture indigenous Brazilian attitudes toward cosmetic surgery.
